item.title: ‘Saturday Night Live UK’: Where to Watch the Season 1 Finale Online
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest updates on entertainment and streaming. Today, we're talking about a big milestone for Saturday Night Live - it's officially expanding outside of the United States to the United Kingdom with Saturday Night Live UK. The season 1 finale is just around the corner, and we've got the scoop on how to watch it."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The finale will be hosted by Doctor Who actor Ncuti Gatwa, with British singer/songwriter Holly Humberstone as the musical guest. If you're in the UK, you can catch it live on Sky UK on Saturday, May 16 at 10 p.m. BST. But if you're in the US, don't worry - it'll be available on Peacock the following day, Sunday, May 17 at 9 p.m. ET/6 p.m. PT."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Now, if you want to watch SNL UK online without breaking the bank, we've got a clever workaround for you. You can sign up for a 30-day trial of Walmart+ for just $1, which includes access to Peacock as one of its perks. Alternatively, you can subscribe to Peacock directly for $10.99 per month. Or, if you want to watch it live, you can use ExpressVPN, which starts at just $2.79 per month with an annual plan."
[Short music transition]
Host: "By the way, Ncuti Gatwa is also starring in a play called Born With Teeth at London's Wyndham's Theatre, and Holly Humberstone just released her debut album Cruel World. SNL UK features a talented cast of British comedy actors and comedians, including Hammed Animashaun, Ayoade Bamgboye, and many more."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode. Don't forget to check out the promo reel for this weekend's episode of SNL UK, and we'll see you soon!"
